'''Landing Nest''' was one of the major [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] facilities on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lo'Uran]]. The spaceport was diligently maintained by the [[850.AA Public Service Headquarters]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] named [[Enell]].
